decisions.statement: Every page of that page type is answered in this one answer.
The page type the properties are is the one argument.
A page type that is no page property is refused before any body is worked out.
A page type no page is of is refused rather than answered as no edit.
Every page of that page type gains the key and hands its type on.
The file the type lands at is the `types` file beside the page property.
The type carried over is the one named for the page property's slug.
A types file that is not there yet is written rather than refused.
The type leaves the page's own body, and every body naming it is repointed.
A page stating its type already is passed over rather than stating it twice.
A run every page of which states its type already is refused as no edit.
Each page's type is carried over the edits the pages before it left.
A folder named holds the change to the pages sitting under that folder.
One page refused refuses the whole change, and the refusal names that page.

definition: every page property of one page type turned over to the code writing its type
